# Character assets

- human.glb — original rigged human by Quaternius, distributed by UMRAM-Bilkent/supine-human-model. CC0 1.0. Source: https://github.com/UMRAM-Bilkent/supine-human-model/blob/main/assets/human.glb
- husky.gltf — rigged Husky from Quaternius Ultimate Animated Animal Pack. CC0 1.0. Source: https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimateanimatedanimals.html (mirrored file: https://github.com/agentkaerf/FreeModels/blob/main/Ultimate%20Animated%20Animals%20-%20July%202021/glTF/Husky.gltf)
- addons/utils/SkeletonUtils.js — Three.js r160, MIT License. Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r160/examples/jsm/utils/SkeletonUtils.js

The models are included locally so the visualization does not depend on a third-party host at runtime.
